description: A selected slug that no item of the graph carries. The selection names ghost twice; after de-duplication it gives one conflict, {code AGSC-E802, key selection, pair [ghost, ghost]}, the slug written twice because a pair always holds two members. worker is present and requires store, which Step 1 adds with its path, and api-v0, which no item carries: that is the conflict with key requires and the pair in code-point order, api-v0 before worker, not requiring item first. conflicts[] is sorted by pair. Either conflict makes the composition invalid, so the verdict is returned alone with exit 1 and no Harness.
